messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Two knowledge-graph relations extracted from drug information texts are given below. Decide whether they express the same meaning with the same subject/object direction, so that they can be merged into one relation without losing information.

Relation A: 'distributed from' defined as 'The subject drug brand is distributed or licensed from the company specified by the object entity.'
Example triple with A: ["Crestor", "distributed from", "Shionogi & Co., LTD"]
Relation B: 'has generic name' defined as 'The subject drug is sold under or known by the generic (non-proprietary) name specified by the object entity.'
Example triple with B: null

Can every use of relation A be replaced by relation B? Answer with only "yes" or "no".
Answer:
